name: Marvale
description: The brown-dwarf light of Marvale has guided three generations of drift miners and twice as many ghosts. The outer dark holds dwarf worlds nobody bothered to name, each colder than the last. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

stars.name: Red Wick
stars.description: A brown-dwarf of 0.05806 solar masses, deuterium fusion only against the dark. It radiates leftover formation heat, cooling a fraction each century. Every chart in the arm uses it as a bearing star, willing or not.

planets.name: Stormbank
planets.description: Methane haze wraps a slushy mantle, cold and blue and utterly calm. Diamond rain is theorized below, though no probe has returned to confirm. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

planets.name: Vaporholm
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Subsurface warmth is rumored, and twice confirmed, and never shared. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

moons.name: Quartz Flint IV
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Shallow Scree I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Gildedward
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. The air itself is a hazard the suits filter with complaint. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

planets.name: Drownedfield
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

comets.name: Grey Stranger 4
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
